text:
maya: Heads-up — partner vendor just flagged a capacity degradation across APAC (throughput ~40% down). They mentioned a potential failover window in ~30m. Can we pre-book a short carve in us-west2 for a canary? @liam @sophie :hourglass:
liam: What's the SKU/instance family and zone they expect to degrade? I can check quotas quickly. Also how many concurrent slots do we need for the canary? :thinking_face:
sophie: They called out h100-like instances (h100v2 equiv) and said apac-southeast1 is most affected. Ticket opened with partner (TKT-24892). I asked them for exact SKU list and ETA. For the canary, thinking 4-6 GPUs for 1h to validate failover.
liam: Quick quota check command you can run if you want to verify locally:
liam: `gcloud compute accelerators describe --project=redwood-inference --zone=us-west2-a --format=json`
kai: If we only need a short canary, we can also try lowering model footprints (quantized) to fit into A500 slots and reduce GPU count. That avoids touching reserved capacity if ops prefers that.
sophie: @maya fwiw I asked procurement to hold a soft carve with vendor for 2h in us-west2. They'll confirm if it's billable. Vendor replied with a provisional reservation id.
vendor-bot: Partner update: degraded throughput observed in apac regions. Rebalancing plan initiated. Provisional reservation offered: PRSV-7721 (subject to confirmation). ETA for stabilization: 45-90m.
maya: Ok — who can flip the autoscaler to use us-west2 canary route if vendor signals full failover? Need a runbook step and an owner.
liam: I can own the routing flip. Plan: 1) enable canary route in `routes/config` to point 10% traffic to us-west2 pool, 2) monitor p50/p95 for 10m, 3) widen if stable. I'll open a PR to the routing config now.
liam: PR link (will post once created). Quick check: do we have pre-warmed images in us-west2 for the h100-like task? If not, startup latency will bite.
sophie: We have a prewarm AMI for a500 in us-west2, h100 images are only in eu and apac right now. If liam wants to run canary on a500 quantized model, it's ready.
kai: Suggestion: run the canary on quantized fp16->int8 profile to cut GPU mem ~40% and test inference correctness. If metrics look good, we can expand without vendor carve.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary route enable scheduled by liam at 4978881600. Will run k8s rollout in dev and then promo to canary. :robot_face:
maya: Sweet — thanks. liam, please paste the PR and the short runbook steps here. Sophie, keep vendor ticket updated and ping me if they change ETA. :thumbsup:
liam: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/routes/merge_requests/423 — runbook in PR description. TL;DR:
```
1. Set `routes.canary.percent=10`
2. Apply `kubectl apply -f canary.yaml` in us-west2 cluster
3. Watch /metrics route p50/p95 and error-rate for 10m
4. If p95 < 300ms and error < 0.5%, increase to 30%, else rollback
```
liam: I'll start the rollout only after confirmation from procurement that the provisional reservation PRSV-7721 is non-blocking.
sophie: Procurement confirmed provisional carve is non-blocking for 2h. Vendor will bill if used longer. Updated ticket TKT-24892.
maya: Great. I'll post an update to #oncall when we flip. Thanks all. :eyes:
